newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila okays Itochu-led industrial estate project.
newsitem.headline: Manila okays Itochu-led industrial estate project.

text.p: The Philippine Economic Zone Authority has approved a 300-hectare industrial estate to be developed by a group of investors led by Itochu Corp of Japan, documents released on Tuesday showed.
The 300-hectare lot in Tarlac, north of Manila, has been declared a special economic zone with tax and tariff exemptions.
The project is a joint venture between Rizal Commercial Banking Corp, unlisted Pilipinas Development and Trading Corp and Hacienda Luisita Inc.
Development is estimated to cost 1.959 billion pesos.
The group wants non-pollutant, labour-intensive, small and medium-scale enterprises to invest in the zone.
